systems.postDeploy:
C=$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -m1 '^rtsp-engine'); [ -n "$C" ] || exit 0
echo "Waiting for the engine to become healthy (up to 3 minutes)..."
ok=0; for i in $(seq 1 90); do s=$(docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' "$C" 2>/dev/null); [ "$s" = healthy ] && { ok=1; break; }; sleep 2; done
[ "$ok" = 1 ] || { echo "Engine is not healthy yet. Set the admin password later: Manage > Reset admin password"; exit 0; }
PW=$(od -An -N15 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')
R=$(printf '%s\n' "$PW" | docker exec -i "$C" /app/rtsp-engine admin bootstrap --password-stdin 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)
case "$R" in created|set) echo "Admin login : admin / $PW   (shown once, must be changed at the first sign-in)";; unchanged) echo "Admin account already set up, left as it is";; *) echo "Could not prepare the admin account. Use Manage > Reset admin password";; esac

loginHint.title: Login hint: RTSP Engine web page
lines: Username: admin. The password is printed at the end of the deploy log ("Admin login : admin / ...").

loginHint.command: sudo docker exec rtsp-engine /app/rtsp-engine admin reset-password admin
